messages:
Raj: Quick heads-up — CloudNimble wants us to onboard a new AP-Southwest region (edge capacity + marketplace SKU). They want a soft-launch in ~3 weeks. Need quota approval, marketplace SKU entitlement, SI integration plan, and a joint announcement window. Who can own which pieces?
Mei: We confirmed partner hardware & region assignment. Marketplace SKU will be `cloudnimble-rlm-gpu-v1`. They also require KMS key access for image pull. ETA from partner side: ~2 weeks for certs.
Carlos: We currently only have 2 A100 slots free in ap-southwest. We need 4x A100s reserved for Dedicated pool. Filing a quota raise now. Example payload I sent to cloud support:
```
{ "region": "ap-southwest", "resource": "GPU", "type": "A100", "requested_count": 4, "purpose": "Dedicated inference pool for CloudNimble" }
```
Raj: Can Partnerships assemble a quick checklist for marketplace onboarding (entitlements, billing SKU, legal links) and share blackout dates for joint PR? :calendar:
Emma: Marketing note — prefer announcement window wk of Apr 21 so product + partner comms align. Need final copy 5 business days before.
Lina: Legal flag — must run joint announcement through partner counsel and add a brief MSA addendum re: data residency. I need final PR copy at least 5 days prior to public.
Ben: Sales request — partner asked for target SLOs and list pricing. They expect 99.9% uptime and ~50ms p95 for small-model inference. Do we have precedent pricing for a SKU with reserved A100s?
Raj: Owners: Carlos -> quota & infra ticket; Mei -> partner SKUs + KMS contact + entitlements; Emma -> announcement + comms plan; Lina -> legal + MSA addendum; Ben -> pricing/SI handoff doc. I'll track in the partners sheet: https://drive/relaunch/partner-onboard (private).
deploy-bot: Calendar invite created — "CloudNimble AP-SW launch sync" Mon Apr 14 10:00 PDT.
Carlos: Quota ticket submitted (ticket CN-4821). Cloud provider replied: they need an architecture diagram and expected usage profile (tokens/sec, concurrency).
Mei: Uploaded usage profile and architecture diagram to the drive link above. Peak concurrency ~180 rps, sustained ~60 rps, KV-cache expected. Partner also provided contact for KMS: kms-admin@cloudnimble.com.
Raj: Nice. Next steps: Mei send SKU & KMS contact by EOD tomorrow, Carlos update ticket with diagrams, Lina start NDA/annex draft, Emma schedule joint dry run 3 days before the targeted announcement. Ping me if anything slips. :thumbsup:
